title: A Guide to the (Latest) Impeachment Trial

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 Dealbook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 纽约时报。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最有影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经删减的实时对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月在 nytimes.com 上为所有人免费直播精选采访

sentences.en: 18th.
If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费阅读权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily today.
sentences.zh: 这是每日头条。

sentences.en: The Senate begins hearing arguments this afternoon in the latest impeachment trial of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 参议院将于今天下午开始听取唐纳德·特朗普最新弹劾案的辩论。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, Jim Rudenberg, about what to expect from the prosecution and the defense.
sentences.zh: 我与我的同事吉姆·鲁登伯格谈论了对控方和辩方的期望。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, February 9th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月9日，星期二。

sentences.en: So, Jim, this is our second Senate impeachment trial of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 所以，吉姆，这是我们对唐纳德·特朗普的第二次参议院弹劾审判。

sentences.en: And as a result, it feels like we don't really need to explain to listeners how impeachment works as a process because we just went through it not very long ago.
sentences.zh: 因此，感觉我们真的不需要向听众解释弹劾的运作过程，因为不久前我们刚刚经历过。

sentences.en: So, I think I just want to start by asking you to explain the case that will be made here on both sides.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想先请你解释一下双方在这里将提出的论点。

sentences.en: And I wonder if you could start by reading from the article of impeachment that was adopted by the House of Representatives that
sentences.zh: 我想请你首先朗读由众议院通过的弹劾条款，该条款

sentences.en: basically serves as the indictment against Trump in this trial.
sentences.zh: 基本上在这次审判中充当针对特朗普的起诉书。

sentences.en: Yeah, Michael, in a lot of ways, this is a much simpler case, right?
sentences.zh: 是的，迈克尔，在很多方面，这是一个简单得多的案件，对吧？

sentences.en: Because in the last impeachment, it was complicated.
sentences.zh: 因为在上一次弹劾中，情况很复杂。

sentences.en: It dealt with officials in Ukraine, this faraway place.
sentences.zh: 它涉及乌克兰的官员，那个遥远的地方。

sentences.en: There were lots of ins and outs.
sentences.zh: 里面有很多细节和曲折。

sentences.en: You had to really get into the weeds to understand it.
sentences.zh: 你必须真正深入细节才能理解它。

sentences.en: And this is very simple.
sentences.zh: 而这个非常简单。

sentences.en: Did the president's words lead to chaos on this critical day for the American democracy?
sentences.zh: 总统的话是否在这个对美利坚民主至关重要的日子里导致了混乱？

sentences.en: And it's only one article of impeachment.
sentences.zh: 而且只有一条弹劾条款。

sentences.en: And it has to do with what took place before our very eyes on January 6th.
sentences.zh: 这与我们在1月6日亲眼目睹的事情有关。

sentences.en: Let me read from this article.
sentences.zh: 让我读一下这条条款。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引述：

sentences.en: President Trump gravely endangered the security of the United States and its institutions of government.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统严重危害了美国及其政府机构的安全。

sentences.en: He threatened the integrity of the democratic system, interfered with the peaceful transition of power, and imperiled a co-equal branch of government.
sentences.zh: 他威胁了民主制度的完整性，干涉了权力的和平过渡，并危及了一个平等的政府部门。

sentences.en: He thereby betrayed his trust as president to the manifest injury of the people of the United States.
sentences.zh: 因此，他背叛了作为总统的信托，对美国人民造成了明显的伤害。

sentences.en: That's effectively the case.
sentences.zh: 这实际上就是案情所在。

sentences.en: Okay, so given that charge, how do you expect the Democrats, the prosecutors in this trial, to prove that happened, that he incited this riot?
sentences.zh: 好的，鉴于这项指控，你预计民主党人（本次审判中的检察官）将如何证明这一点，证明他煽动了这场骚乱？

sentences.en: What will their arguments look like as they take to the floor of the Senate starting on Tuesday morning?
sentences.zh: 当他们从周二上午开始走上参议院发言席时，他们的论点会是什么样的？

sentences.en: Well, they've laid this out in their trial brief, and they are not only focusing on what he said or did on January 6th, which is vitally important to their case.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他们在审判简报中已经阐述了这一点，他们不仅关注他在1月6日所说或所做的事情，这对他们的案件至关重要。

sentences.en: I'm not saying it isn't.
sentences.zh: 我并不是说它不重要。

sentences.en: But they pull back the lens, and what they are arguing is that over the course of weeks, if not months, the president
sentences.zh: 但他们拉远镜头，他们争辩说，在数周甚至数月的时间里，总统

sentences.en: was building this case of a stolen election in such an overwhelming way, making the argument so ubiquitous
sentences.zh: 以如此压倒性的方式构建了这场关于窃取选举的案件，使得这一论点无处不在

sentences.en: that he led his followers to draw the conclusion that the only thing they could do was to take matters into their own hands to defend the democracy.
sentences.zh: 以至于他引导追随者得出结论，他们唯一能做的就是自己采取行动来捍卫民主。

sentences.en: And Jim, where does that timeline start for the Democrats in this trial, if, as you say, they are really zooming out and back?
sentences.zh: 吉姆，如果像你所说的那样，民主党人确实在将镜头拉远和回溯，那么他们在这次审判中的时间线是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: It goes all the way back to well before the election.
sentences.zh: 它一直追溯到选举前很久。

sentences.en: Well before the election.
sentences.zh: 选举前很久。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he is asked, When, loser drawl in this election, will you commit here today for a peaceful transfer of power after the election?
sentences.zh: 有人问他，在这场选举中无论输赢，你今天是否会承诺在选举后和平移交权力？

sentences.en: Whether he would commit to making sure there is a peaceful transfer of power.
sentences.zh: 他是否会承诺确保权力的和平移交。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And he says,
sentences.zh: 他说：

sentences.en: Well, we're going to have to see what happens.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们得看看会发生什么。

sentences.en: You know that I've been complaining very strongly about the ballots, and the ballots are a disaster.
sentences.zh: 你知道我对选票的抱怨非常强烈，选票是一场灾难。

sentences.en: We're going to have to see what happens.
sentences.zh: 我们得看看会发生什么。

sentences.en: So starting in the summer, Democrats will contend, Trump begins seeding this idea that he might not
sentences.zh: 因此，民主党人将辩称，从夏天开始，特朗普就开始散播他可能不会接受选举结果的种子

sentences.en: accept the results of the election, and that there is very likely to be fraud, corruption, abuse in the election.
sentences.zh: 并且选举中极有可能存在欺诈、腐败和滥用职权。

sentences.en: Not only that mail voting is susceptible to corruption, but that Trump is so popular, and before the pandemic, the economy was doing so well, that the only way Trump could lose...
sentences.zh: 不仅邮寄投票容易产生腐败，而且特朗普如此受欢迎，大流行之前经济表现如此之好，以至于特朗普可能会输的唯一原因……

sentences.en: Because the only way we're going to lose this election is if the election is rigged.
sentences.zh: 因为我们输掉这场选举的唯一方法就是选举被操纵。

sentences.en: Remember that.
sentences.zh: 记住这一点。

sentences.en: It's the only way we're going to lose this election.
sentences.zh: 这是我们输掉这场选举的唯一方法。

sentences.en: ...was if there was corruption.
sentences.zh: ……除非存在腐败。

sentences.en: Only corruption could beat Trump.
sentences.zh: 只有腐败才能击败特朗普。

sentences.en: If he loses, that's the only explanation.
sentences.zh: 如果他输了，这就是唯一的解释。

sentences.en: And that was an argument that he made for a very long time as well.
sentences.zh: 这也是他很长一段时间以来一直在提出的论点。

sentences.en: Okay, so what's the next point in this timeline for the Democrats?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么民主党人这条时间线上的下一个重点是什么？

sentences.en: The next big moment comes during the presidential debates.
sentences.zh: 下一个重要时刻出现在总统辩论期间。

sentences.en: And once again, during this debate...
sentences.zh: 再一次，在这场辩论中……

sentences.en: Will you pledge tonight that you will not declare victory until the election has been independently certified?
sentences.zh: 你今晚能否承诺，在选举获得独立认证之前，你不会宣布胜利？

sentences.en: The president says he will not go along with conceding the election.
sentences.zh: 总统表示他不会顺从接受选举结果。

sentences.en: If it's a fair election, I am 100% on board.
sentences.zh: 如果这是一场公平的选举，我100%支持。

sentences.en: But if I see tens of thousands of ballots being manipulated, I can't go along with that.
sentences.zh: 但如果我看到数万张选票被操纵，我无法接受这一点。

sentences.en: Very big deal at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时这是一件大事。

sentences.en: We knew it was a big deal at the time.
sentences.zh: 我们当时就知道这是一件大事。

sentences.en: And in fact, there's a second very important moment at the debate where he's then asked...
sentences.zh: 事实上，辩论中还有第二个非常重要的时刻，当时有人问他……

sentences.en: Will you urge your supporters to stay calm during this extended period, not to engage in any civil unrest?
sentences.zh: 你会敦促你的支持者在这个漫长的时期保持冷静，不要参与任何民间骚乱吗？

sentences.en: And will you pledge...
sentences.zh: 你是否会承诺……

sentences.en: Will he urge his supporters to stay calm during what's going to be a complicated process of counting votes?
sentences.zh: 他会敦促他的支持者在即将复杂化的计票过程中保持冷静吗？

sentences.en: Will they not engage in any civil unrest?
sentences.zh: 他们不会参与任何民间骚乱吗？

sentences.en: And we'll all remember this moment, the president and Chris Wallace go back and forth over this.
sentences.zh: 我们都会记住这一刻，总统和克里斯·华莱士就此进行了来回交锋。

sentences.en: Are you willing tonight to condemn white supremacists and militia groups and to say that they need to stand
sentences.zh: 你今晚是否愿意谴责白人至上主义者和民兵组织，并表示他们需要退居二线

sentences.en: down and not add to the violence in a number of these cities, as we saw in Kenosha and as we've seen in Portland?
sentences.zh: 而不是加剧其中许多城市的暴力，正如我们在基诺沙看到的以及在波特兰看到的那样？

sentences.en: Sure, I'm willing to do that.
sentences.zh: 当然，我愿意这样做。

sentences.en: Are you prepared to specifically?
sentences.zh: 你准备好具体说明了吗？

sentences.en: Do it.
sentences.zh: 做吧。

sentences.en: Well, go ahead, sir.
sentences.zh: 好吧，请吧，先生。

sentences.en: I would say almost everything I see is from the left wing, not from the right wing.
sentences.zh: 我想说，我看到几乎所有东西都来自左翼，而不是右翼。

sentences.en: So what are you saying?
sentences.zh: 那你到底在说什么？

sentences.en: I'm willing to do anything.
sentences.zh: 我愿意做任何事。

sentences.en: I want to see peace.
sentences.zh: 我希望看到和平。

sentences.en: Well, then do it, sir.
sentences.zh: 那你就去做吧，先生。

sentences.en: Say it.
sentences.zh: 说出来。

sentences.en: And Chris Wallace mentions the Proud Boys, a well-known, quote-unquote, Western chauvinist militant group.
sentences.zh: 克里斯·华莱士提到了“骄傲男孩”，一个著名的、所谓的“西方沙文主义武装组织”。

sentences.en: And the president says, stand back and stand by.
sentences.zh: 总统说，后退并待命。

sentences.en: But I'll tell you what.
sentences.zh: 但我告诉你吧。

sentences.en: And we will hear this again and again.
sentences.zh: 我们会一次又一次地听到这句话。

sentences.en: Stand back and stand by in addressing the Proud Boys.
sentences.zh: 在向骄傲男孩喊话时说“后退并待命”。

sentences.en: It's an absolute killer line as far as the Democrats are concerned in their case.
sentences.zh: 就民主党人的案子而言，这是一句绝对致命的话。

sentences.en: OK, what's next?
sentences.zh: 好的，接下来是什么？

sentences.en: Well, next is a moment in late September that was sort of lost in all the news of the time.
sentences.zh: 接下来是9月下旬的一个时刻，在当时的所有新闻中有点被淹没了。

sentences.en: And that is when a Biden bus, branded with the Biden-Harris logo, is driving down the highway in Texas.
sentences.zh: 那就是一辆印有拜登-哈里斯标志的拜登竞选大巴正在德克萨斯州的高速公路上行驶。

sentences.en: And it suddenly comes across a caravan of Trump supporters in pickup trucks, flying the Trump flag.
sentences.zh: 它突然遇到了一支由挂着特朗普旗帜的皮卡车组成的特朗普支持者车队。

sentences.en: Look at that.
sentences.zh: 看看那个。

sentences.en: These pickup trucks and automobiles start swarming the bus and driving very fast and trying to cut it off.
sentences.zh: 这些皮卡车和汽车开始蜂拥包围大巴，开得很快并试图拦截它。

sentences.en: And they almost run it off the road.
sentences.zh: 他们差点把它逼出公路。

sentences.en: Running them out of Texas?
sentences.zh: 把他们赶出德克萨斯州？

sentences.en: It is hilarious.
sentences.zh: 这太搞笑了。

sentences.en: And there's great outrage across both parties initially.
sentences.zh: 最初两党都对此感到极其愤怒。

sentences.en: But then the president instead basically goads them along.
sentences.zh: 但随后总统不仅没有阻止，反而基本上在怂恿他们。

sentences.en: He celebrates it.
sentences.zh: 他在为之庆祝。

sentences.en: He tweets a stylized video, as the Democratic brief describes it, of the caravan and captioned it, quote, I love Texas, with an exclamation mark.
sentences.zh: 正如民主党简报所描述的那样，他发了一条带有车队特技视频的推文，并配文：“我爱德克萨斯”，后面加了一个感叹号。

sentences.en: Days later, he calls them patriots who, quote-unquote, did nothing wrong.
sentences.zh: 几天后，他称他们为“绝对没有做错任何事”的爱国者。

sentences.en: So, again, a moment where people could have been hurt.
sentences.zh: 所以，再次强调，这是一个可能有人受伤的时刻。

sentences.en: This is really a dicey moment.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一个棘手的时刻。

sentences.en: And he is fully endorsing it.
sentences.zh: 而他完全在纵容它。

sentences.en: Then we get to the election and election night slash early morning of the following day.
sentences.zh: 然后我们迎来了选举以及选举之夜到次日清晨。

sentences.en: And what the president says at this moment is going to be very critical to the whole campaign that follows and therefore critical to this impeachment trial.
sentences.zh: 总统在这个时刻所说的话对随后的整个竞选活动至关重要，因此对这次弹劾审判也至关重要。

sentences.en: And that is that at 2.30 in the morning...
sentences.zh: 那就是在凌晨2点30分……

sentences.en: Well, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好吧，非常感谢。

sentences.en: ...the president is livid.
sentences.zh: ……总统愤怒不已。

sentences.en: Millions and millions of people voted for us tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚有数百万乃至数千万人把票投给了我们。

sentences.en: And a very sad group of people is trying to disenfranchise that group of people.
sentences.zh: 而一小撮非常可悲的人正试图剥夺这群人的投票权。

sentences.en: And we won't stand for it.
sentences.zh: 我们不会容忍这一点。

sentences.en: We will not stand for it.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不容忍这一点。

sentences.en: He's watched his lead slip away.
sentences.zh: 他看着自己的领先优势一点点滑走。

sentences.en: Now, mind you, he knew this was going to happen ahead of time.
sentences.zh: 现在请注意，他提前就知道会发生这种事。

sentences.en: We know he knew this.
sentences.zh: 我们知道他知道这一点。

sentences.en: We all knew this was going to happen ahead of time.
sentences.zh: 我们大家提前都知道会发生这种事。

sentences.en: The networks had prepared their coverage and their viewers.
sentences.zh: 各大电视网已经为他们的报道和观众做好了准备。

sentences.en: And we had prepared our readers.
sentences.zh: 我们也为我们的读者做好了准备。

sentences.en: This is how this count's going to go.
sentences.zh: 计票过程将会是这样的。

sentences.en: But the president comes out at 2.30 in the morning in the East Room
sentences.zh: 但总统在东厅的凌晨2点30分出场

sentences.en: and just lays down a marker that he won and that this is an unbelievable fraud.
sentences.zh: 并明确表示他赢了，这是一场令人难以置信的欺诈。

sentences.en: And the reason that this refrain that he makes at 2.30 in the morning is so important is because it will form the basis of everything that follows.
sentences.zh: 他之所以在凌晨2点30分发表这番言论如此重要，是因为它将构成随后一切行动的基础。

sentences.en: President Trump will repeat this over and over again.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统将一遍又一遍地重复这一点。

sentences.en: I won, like, by a lot.
sentences.zh: 我赢了，以巨大优势。

sentences.en: This is a fraud on the American public.
sentences.zh: 这是对美国公众的欺诈。

sentences.en: This is an embarrassment to our country.
sentences.zh: 这是我们国家的耻辱。

sentences.en: We were getting ready to win this election.
sentences.zh: 我们正准备赢得这场选举。

sentences.en: Frankly, we did win this election.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我们确实赢了这场选举。

sentences.en: And importantly, at the same time, there is a legal strategy built around an argument of a fraudulent election that his lawyers begin pursuing.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，与此同时，围绕选举欺诈论点建立了一项法律战略，他的律师们开始推行该战略。

sentences.en: And those lawsuits, as they keep losing in court, you would think, and I think a lot of people thought this at the time,
sentences.zh: 随着这些诉讼在法庭上不断败诉，你会这么想，而且我想当时很多人也这么想，

sentences.en: oh, well, these cases are, they're losing and they're meaningless.
sentences.zh: 哦，好吧，这些案件，它们在败诉，而且毫无意义。

sentences.en: In fact, they were doing something very important.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们在做一件非常重要的事情。

sentences.en: And the important thing they were doing was they were sanctifying, at least in the PR campaign for Trump supporters, that this was somehow official,
sentences.zh: 他们正在做的重要事情是，他们正在（至少在针对特朗普支持者的公关活动中）将其神圣化，证明这是某种官方行为，

sentences.en: that here are official court documents, that we are alleging that this fraud was so bad.
sentences.zh: 证明这里有官方的法庭文件，证明我们指控这种欺诈行为是如此严重。

sentences.en: It's treated as a real case.
sentences.zh: 它被当作一个真正的案件来对待。

sentences.en: That's very important as we go forward.
sentences.zh: 随着我们继续前进，这一点非常重要。

sentences.en: Let's remember that lawsuits appear to be coming from everywhere.
sentences.zh: 让我们记住，诉讼似乎来自四面八方。

sentences.en: It wasn't just a Trump campaign filing lawsuits.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是特朗普竞选团队在提起诉讼。

sentences.en: It might be some state legislator in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 这可能是密歇根州的某个州议员。

sentences.en: It might be some voter in Georgia or Wisconsin, what have you.
sentences.zh: 可能是佐治亚州或威斯康星州的某个选民，诸如此类。

sentences.en: But almost all of these cases, somehow or another, are being filed by lawyers with Trump connections.
sentences.zh: 但几乎所有这些案件，不知怎么地，都是由与特朗普有联系的律师提起的。

sentences.en: Even perhaps the most important case of all in this endeavor, and that's the Supreme Court filing that the Attorney General of Texas, Ken Paxton, makes,
sentences.zh: 甚至可能是在这方面最重要的一起案件，也就是得克萨斯州总检察长肯·帕克斯顿向最高法院提交的诉状，

sentences.en: seeking to have four states' votes thrown out because, in his argument,
sentences.zh: 试图推翻四个州的投票结果，因为在他的论点中，

sentences.en: Texas voters have been defrauded here because their votes were negated by these unfair votes in the other states.
sentences.zh: 得克萨斯州选民在这里受到了欺骗，因为他们的选票被其他州这些不公的选票抵消了。

sentences.en: And in fact, our reporting showed that that lawsuit was drafted by attorneys close to Trump who then were looked for an attorney general who would be willing to carry it forward.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们的报道显示，该诉讼是由接近特朗普的律师起草的，他们随后寻找了一位愿意将其推进的总检察长。

sentences.en: And in this case, it was Ken Paxton of Texas, who also, by the way, had his own legal problems developing and might have been in need of a pardon.
sentences.zh: 在本案中，正是得克萨斯州的肯·帕克斯顿，顺便说一句，他自己也有法律问题在身，可能需要特赦。

sentences.en: So Democrats are very likely to argue that even when it seemed that this public campaign and this legal effort were not derived from the president or the White House,
sentences.zh: 因此，民主党人很有可能会辩称，即使这场公开竞选和法律行动看起来并非源自总统或白宫，

sentences.en: this evidence keeps bringing things back and closer to President Trump.
sentences.zh: 这些证据不断把事情重新引向并拉近与特朗普总统的关系。

sentences.en: They do not want this to be about the party.
sentences.zh: 他们不想让这变成关于政党的问题。

sentences.en: Any opportunity to make this about President Trump, they will make that.
sentences.zh: 任何有机会将其归咎于特朗普总统的机会，他们都会利用。

sentences.en: Because, by the way, a lot of their jury is in that party.
sentences.zh: 因为顺便说一句，他们的很多陪审员就在那个党里。

sentences.en: So whenever they can bring it back to the man himself, they will do that.
sentences.zh: 所以每当他们能把焦点拉回到这个人本身时，他们就会这么做。

sentences.en: But I just want to make another point about the Supreme Court case because I think it's important, and I think it was a loss to us at the time a little bit.
sentences.zh: 但我只想就最高法院的案件再谈一点，因为我认为这很重要，而且我认为当时对我们来说算是一点损失。

sentences.en: And that's that what President Trump was building around the Supreme Court case, and a lot of his media allies and party allies were building,
sentences.zh: 那就是特朗普总统围绕最高法院案件所构建的东西，以及他的许多媒体盟友和党内盟友所构建的东西，

sentences.en: was that the Supreme Court will do the right thing here.
sentences.zh: 是最高法院在这里会做出正确的决定。

sentences.en: That if you're now a passionate follower of President Trump, you believe everything he's telling you.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，如果你现在是特朗普总统的狂热追随者，你就会相信他告诉你的一切。

sentences.en: So he is telling you that not only has he been robbed, but you've been robbed.
sentences.zh: 所以他在告诉你，不仅他被抢劫了，你们也被抢劫了。

sentences.en: So the Supreme Court is now becoming the receptacle of all the hopes of Trump supporters that they will do the right thing.
sentences.zh: 因此，最高法院现在成了特朗普支持者所有希望的容器，寄希望于他们会做正确的事。

sentences.en: So on December 11th, when the Supreme Court does not do the right thing, the letdown is intense.
sentences.zh: 所以在12月11日，当最高法院没有做正确的事时，那种失落感是极其强烈的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And, of course, that leads many of these supporters to believe that their last possible chance
sentences.zh: 当然，这导致许多支持者认为，他们纠正这个错误的最后可能机会——

sentences.en: at righting this wrong, again, adopting their language because there was no fraud, is January 6th.
sentences.zh: 再次采用他们的说法，因为根本没有欺诈——就是1月6日。

sentences.en: Right, Michael, because a movement is growing here.
sentences.zh: 没错，迈克尔，因为一场运动正在这里酝酿。

sentences.en: Because what happens after the Supreme Court decision, December 11th, is on December 14th, the Electoral College makes the vote count official.
sentences.zh: 因为在最高法院12月11日做出决定之后，12月14日，选举人团使投票计票结果正式化。

sentences.en: And Trump turns to this idea that January 6th will be his last stand, that he will convince Congress to stop the steal, as it became known in his world.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普则转而认为1月6日将是他的最后决战，他将说服国会“阻止窃选”，正如在他那个世界里所被称为的那样。

sentences.en: They will object to this.
sentences.zh: 他们会对此提出异议。

sentences.en: And he gets very into this idea of a big January 6th Trump rally, the rally to end all rallies.
sentences.zh: 他非常热衷于1月6日举行大型特朗普集会的想法，这是一场史无前例的集会。

sentences.en: And as the Democratic impeachment managers lay out in their brief, he really is putting this January 6th rally in incredibly militaristic terMs.
sentences.zh: 正如民主党弹劾经理们在其辩护摘要中所阐述的那样，他确实在极其军事化的词汇中使用了1月6日的这场集会。

sentences.en: He escalates his public statements and uses more and more incendiary and violent language to urge his supporters to stop the steal.
sentences.zh: 他升级了公开声明，使用越来越多煽动性和暴力的语言来敦促他的支持者阻止窃选。

sentences.en: Can't let it happen.
sentences.zh: 绝不能让这种事发生。

sentences.en: We won't take it anymore.
sentences.zh: 我们再也不会忍气吞声了。

sentences.en: This is the language that the impeachment managers say turns January 6th into, quote, a powder keg waiting to blow.
sentences.zh: 弹劾经理们正是用这种语言将1月6日形容为“一触即发的火药桶”。

sentences.en: I just, again, I want to thank you.
sentences.zh: 我只是，再次感谢你们。

sentences.en: It's just a great honor to have this kind of crowd and to be before you.
sentences.zh: 能有这样的人群并在你们面前讲话，真是一项巨大的荣誉。

sentences.en: Then, of course, we get to that tragic day, January 6th.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然，我们迎来了那个悲惨的日子，1月6日。

sentences.en: The crowds are huge.
sentences.zh: 人群规模庞大。

sentences.en: The president takes the stage.
sentences.zh: 总统登上了演讲台。

sentences.en: And what does he do?
sentences.zh: 他做了什么？

sentences.en: We're going to walk down and I'll be there with you.
sentences.zh: 我们将步行前往，我会和你们在一起。

sentences.en: We're going to walk down.
sentences.zh: 我们将步行前往。

sentences.en: Not only does he urge his supporters to march down to the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 他不仅敦促支持者向国会大厦游行，

sentences.en: Because you'll never take back our country with weakness.
sentences.zh: 因为软弱永远无法夺回我们的国家。

sentences.en: You have to show strength and you have to be strong.
sentences.zh: 你们必须展现力量，你们必须坚强。

sentences.en: But the rhetoric he's using is, And we fight.
sentences.zh: 而且他使用的言辞是：“我们要战斗。”

sentences.en: We're going to fight like hell.
sentences.zh: 我们要拼死战斗。

sentences.en: We fight like hell.
sentences.zh: 我们拼死战斗。

sentences.en: And if you don't fight like hell, you're not going to have a country anymore.
sentences.zh: 如果你不拼死战斗，你将不再拥有国家。

sentences.en: This is going to be a very important video to the Democrats who are going to by now have made a case that there's no logical conclusion for these supporters than to go down to that Capitol and take matters into their own hands when every other American institution has let them down.
sentences.zh: 对于民主党人来说，这将是一个非常重要的视频，他们到目前为止已经提出了这样一个论点：对于这些支持者来说，当其他所有美国机构都让他们失望时，除了走到国会大厦并亲自动手之外，没有别的合乎逻辑的结论。

sentences.en: So in summary, the Democrats' case is that for months, everything was building to January 6th so that in that final speech when Trump told those supporters to march to the Capitol,
sentences.zh: 简而言之，民主党人的论点是，几个月来，一切都在为1月6日积蓄力量，以至于在特朗普告诉那些支持者向国会大厦游行的最后那次演讲中，

sentences.en: the wood was already stacked and that was just the tossing of the match.
sentences.zh: 柴火已经堆好，那只是划着了一根火柴。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能查阅所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费体验《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，即可获得30天的免费访问权。

sentences.en: Okay, so Jim, that's the case against Trump from the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 好的，吉姆，这就是民主党人对特朗普的指控。

sentences.en: What will former President Trump and his lawyers argue in their defense?
sentences.zh: 前总统特朗普和他的律师将如何在辩护中进行反驳？

sentences.en: What will that look and sound like?
sentences.zh: 那会是什么样子，听起来会怎样？

sentences.en: Well, it won't look and sound like what President Trump initially wanted it to look and sound like, as we understand it,
sentences.zh: 嗯，它看起来和听起来不会像特朗普总统最初希望的那样，据我们所知，

sentences.en: which was an argument that he won and it was a rigged election.
sentences.zh: 也就是辩称他赢了，这是一场被操纵的选举。

sentences.en: So that's been dispatched with.
sentences.zh: 所以这种说法已经被抛弃了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think a bunch of lawyers actually quit when asked to make that case.
sentences.zh: 我想有一群律师在被要求提出这种辩护时实际上直接辞职了。

sentences.en: He's gone through a few lawyers and it seems as if his latest team has prevailed upon him to sort of drop that.
sentences.zh: 他换了好几个律师，看起来他最近的团队已经说服他放弃了这种说法。

sentences.en: But there are a couple of different arguments they're making.
sentences.zh: 但他们提出了几种不同的论点。

sentences.en: And the key argument is that Congress does not have a right to do this.
sentences.zh: 核心论点是国会无权这样做。

sentences.en: He's no longer in office.
sentences.zh: 他已经不在任了。

sentences.en: Impeachment in the Constitution specifically talks about removing someone from office.
sentences.zh: 宪法中的弹劾专门讨论的是罢免在职官员。

sentences.en: He's gone and therefore this is a mockery of the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 他已经离任了，因此这是对宪法的嘲弄。

sentences.en: And Jim, is there any legitimacy to that defense?
sentences.zh: 吉姆，这种辩护有任何合法性吗？

sentences.en: It's true he is no longer president, but when he committed the act at the center of the trial, he was president and he was president when the House impeached him.
sentences.zh: 诚然他不再是总统，但当他犯下审判核心的罪行时他是总统，当众议院对其实施弹劾时他也是总统。

sentences.en: Michael, most legal scholars do not support this interpretation, including some prominent Republicans and conservatives.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，大多数法律学者不支持这种解释，其中包括一些杰出的共和党人和保守派。

sentences.en: That the notion of impeachment when the framers were sort of getting this into the Constitution,
sentences.zh: 即当制宪者将这一概念写入宪法时，

sentences.en: that it was already well established that one could be impeached after having left office with the remedy in that case being preventing them from serving in any high office again.
sentences.zh: 当时已经非常明确：一个人在离任后仍然可以被弹劾，其补救措施是在这种情况下禁止他们再次担任任何高级职务。

sentences.en: The president's lawyers, however, are pointing to a single word in the constitutional mandate here,
sentences.zh: 然而，总统的律师们指出了宪法授权中的一个字眼，

sentences.en: and that's and that impeachment is to remove someone from office and prevent them from serving.
sentences.zh: 那就是弹劾是为了免除某人的职务并禁止其任职。

sentences.en: And they're arguing that the first predicate is that the person has to be in office and it's about removal.
sentences.zh: 他们的论点是，首要前提是此人必须在任，而且这涉及罢免。

sentences.en: What about how they will defend more specifically against the case being made by prosecutors that Trump incited this violence?
sentences.zh: 那么他们将如何针对检察官提出的特朗普煽动暴力的指控进行更具体的辩护呢？

sentences.en: The president's lawyers are very focused on his specific words on the 6th.
sentences.zh: 总统的律师非常关注他在6日发表的具体言辞。

sentences.en: And what they are arguing is that if you listen to his words, he is nowhere close to advocating for violence.
sentences.zh: 他们的论点是，如果你听听他的话，他根本没有接近于鼓吹暴力。

sentences.en: In fact, they quote him, and this is true, that during his speech at the Ellipse, he said,
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们引用了他的话，这千真万确，他在椭圆广场的演讲中说过，

sentences.en: I know everyone here will soon be marching over to the Capitol building to peacefully and patriotically make your voices heard.
sentences.zh: 我知道这里的每个人很快都会步行前往国会大厦，和平且爱国地发出你们的声音。

sentences.en: So they're saying there's no explicit call to action or violence in that speech on January 6th.
sentences.zh: 所以他们说在1月6日的演讲中并没有明确呼吁采取行动或暴力。

sentences.en: But, Jim, how do these defense lawyers plan to separate what President Trump said on the 6th from what came before it?
sentences.zh: 但是，吉姆，这些辩护律师打算如何将特朗普总统在6日说的话与之前的事情隔离开来？

sentences.en: Because it sounds like the Democratic case in this trial is that what came before and what was said on the 6th is deeply interconnected.
sentences.zh: 因为听起来民主党在这场审判中的论点是，之前发生的事情和6日说的话是深度交织在一起的。

sentences.en: Well,
sentences.zh: 嗯，

sentences.en: here they'll have an overarching argument that to imply that the president did anything wrong in any of that would be to rob the president of the United States of the fundamental right that all Americans have to free speech.
sentences.zh: 这里他们会有一个首要的论点，即暗示总统在其中任何事情上做了错事，就等于剥夺了美国总统所有美国人拥有的言论自由的基本权利。

sentences.en: And that the president was well within his rights to voice this view that this is a stolen election, that this process wasn't right, and he wasn't inciting a riot.
sentences.zh: 而且总统完全有权表达这种观点，即这是一场被窃取的选举，这个过程是不公正的，他并没有煽动暴乱。

sentences.en: He was speaking the truth as he, they will argue, understood it.
sentences.zh: 他们会辩称，他是在说他所理解的真相。

sentences.en: But, Jim, I think anyone who has been through a high school civics class knows that when it comes to free speech, not all of it is protected.
sentences.zh: 但是，吉姆，我想任何上过高中公民课的人都知道，谈到言论自由时，并非所有言论都受保护。

sentences.en: Yeah, but the president's lawyers are arguing that this, in fact, is not a case of that, that his speech, quote,
sentences.zh: 是的，但总统的律师辩称，事实上这并非那种情况，他的演讲，引述如下，

sentences.en: fell well within the norms of political speech that is protected by the First Amendment.
sentences.zh: 完全符合第一修正案所保护的政治言论规范。

sentences.en: And to try him for that would be to do a grave injustice to the freedom of speech in this country.
sentences.zh: 因此对其实施审判将是对这个国家言论自由的严重不公。

sentences.en: That he was complaining about an election and how more American is that the First Amendment protects the right to say whatever you want about an election and that he should have no less of a right to do that than any other American citizen.
sentences.zh: 他是在抱怨一场选举，还有什么比这更美国化的呢？第一修正案保护就选举发表任何你想发表言论的权利，他应该享有与其他美国公民一样的权利。

sentences.en: So it basically boils down to he is just another American citizen voicing his view under the constitutional right to do so.
sentences.zh: 所以归根结底，他只是在行使其宪法权利发表看法的又一个普通美国公民。

sentences.en: Okay,
sentences.zh: 好的，

sentences.en: so the president's defense team is going to argue both that the Senate doesn't have the right to try a former president and that everything he said is protected anyway under the First Amendment.
sentences.zh: 所以总统的辩护团队将辩称，参议院既无权审判前总统，而且无论如何他所说的一切都受第一修正案保护。

sentences.en: People can say what they want about their views of the election, and that includes Trump.
sentences.zh: 人们可以就自己对选举的看法畅所欲言，其中也包括特朗普。

sentences.en: We could discuss which side has the stronger case here on the merits.
sentences.zh: 我们可以在案情本身上讨论哪一方的论据更有力。

sentences.en: But, of course, we should acknowledge at this point the fundamental reality, which was also the story of the first impeachment trial, which is this is not a legal trial.
sentences.zh: 但当然，我们此时应当承认一个基本现实，这也是第一场弹劾审判的故事，那就是这不是一场法律审判。

sentences.en: It's a political trial, and we know that there are not 17 Republican votes necessary in the Senate to convict former President Trump.
sentences.zh: 这是一场政治审判，我们知道参议院里并没有定罪前总统特朗普所需的17张共和党选票。

sentences.en: So where does that leave us, knowing what the Senate is about to acquit Trump for having done?
sentences.zh: 那么，鉴于参议院即将宣告特朗普无罪，我们该何去何从？

sentences.en: I think what we have to grapple with is what we now consider status quo political speech.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们必须应对的是我们现在视为现状的政治言论。

sentences.en: Is there a limit to what a sitting president can say about the election system and whether he or she lost an election when it's clear that he or she did?
sentences.zh: 在明知某位在任总统输掉选举的情况下，他或她在选举系统以及是否输掉选举方面可以发表的言论是否存在界限？

sentences.en: And a lot of the Republican defense is around the notion that this was just political speech.
sentences.zh: 很多共和党人的辩护都围绕着这只不过是政治言论这一概念。

sentences.en: They actually quote the Supreme Court in one decision saying the language of the political arena is often vituperative, abusive, and inexact.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至在一次裁决中引用最高法院的话说，政治领域的语言往往是辱骂性的、攻击性的且不精确的。

sentences.en: And what they are basically saying is effectively, I guess, there's no limit to that.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上是在说，我想实际上，对此没有任何限制。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And if all political speech turns out to be OK, no matter how big the lie, no matter whether it contributes to violence, what will that mean for the American Democratic experiment,
sentences.zh: 如果所有的政治言论最终都被认为是没问题的，无论谎言多大，无论它是否助长了暴力，这对美国的民主实验意味着什么，

sentences.en: especially in a moment of such widespread misinformation and disinformation?
sentences.zh: 特别是在这样一个虚假信息和谣言广泛传播的时刻？

sentences.en: Well, Michael, at the expense of my reputation on the daily as Mr. Sunshine, it's how can you look at that as anything that's good?
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克尔，以牺牲我在《每日新闻》作为“阳光先生”的声誉为代价，你怎么能把这看作是什么好事呢？

sentences.en: I mean, even none other than the Senate leader, Mitch McConnell, a rock-ribbed conservative, said that what Trump had said in motion threatened to send democracy into,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，连坚定保守派、参议院领袖米奇·麦康奈尔都说过，特朗普所引发的言论有可能将民主送入，

sentences.en: quote unquote, a death spiral.
sentences.zh: 引述原话，“死亡螺旋”。

sentences.en: So it's taking us into an uncharted place.
sentences.zh: 所以这正把我们带到一个未知的领域。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And not a good place.
sentences.zh: 而且不是什么好地方。

sentences.en: Not a good place.
sentences.zh: 不是好地方。

sentences.en: Well, Jim, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，吉姆，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We'll stay in touch throughout the trial.
sentences.zh: 我们在审判期间会保持联系。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们对此深表感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you so much, Michael.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: The trial will begin at 1 p.m.
sentences.zh: 审判将于东部时间下午1点开始，

sentences.en: Eastern with four hours of debate about whether a former president can be tried by the Senate.
sentences.zh: 首先进行四个小时的辩论，讨论前总统是否可以由参议院审判。

sentences.en: If, as expected, a simple majority of senators agree to move forward, House impeachment managers will begin presenting their case tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 如果如预期那样，参议院的简单多数同意继续推进，众议院弹劾经理们将于明天开始陈述他们的案情。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Monday, for the first time since the start of his trial on corruption charges, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu appeared in court where he declared his innocence,
sentences.zh: 周一，自腐败指控审判开始以来，以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡首次出庭，他在庭上宣称自己无罪，

sentences.en: thanked the judges, then walked out in the middle of the hearing.
sentences.zh: 感谢了法官，然后在听证会中途走了出去。

sentences.en: The trial of a sitting prime minister amid the pandemic and political deadlock so severe that Netanyahu cannot form a governing coalition has riveted the nation of Israel.
sentences.zh: 在严重到内塔尼亚胡无法组建执政联盟的政治僵局以及大流行背景下，对一位在任总理的审判吸引了整个以色列全国的关注。

sentences.en: Outside the courtroom, protesters demanded that Netanyahu be held accountable for his alleged crimes, which include granting political favors in exchange for lavish gifts.
sentences.zh: 在法庭外，抗议者要求内塔尼亚胡为其被指控的罪行承担责任，这些罪行包括以豪华礼物换取政治恩惠。

sentences.en: Representative Ron Wright, a Republican from Texas, has died after contracting COVID-19, becoming the first sitting member of Congress to succumb to the virus.
sentences.zh: 来自得克萨斯州的共和党众议员罗恩·赖特在感染新冠肺炎后去世，成为首位死于该病毒的在任国会议员。

sentences.en: Wright, who was 67, had previously been diagnosed with lung cancer.
sentences.zh: 现年67岁的赖特此前曾被诊断患有肺癌。

sentences.en: He tested positive for COVID-19 on January 21St.
sentences.zh: 他在1月21日的新冠病毒检测中呈阳性。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Robert Chimison, Astha Chaturvedi, Luke Vanderplugge, Alexandra Lee Young, and Sidney Harper.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由罗伯特·奇米森、阿斯哈·查图维迪、卢克·范德普鲁格、亚历山德拉·李·杨和西德尼·哈珀制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Paige Cowett and Lisa Tobin and engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由佩奇·科维特和丽莎·托宾编辑，克里斯·伍德担任音频工程。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个受到严密控制的机器一样运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了数位自诩为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时甚至令人激动的内斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和萨拉·科尼格主持的最新一期《都市》节目中，将讲述人们试图维持其影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
